information.description: A compound lower-body exercise focusing on knee and hip extension.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
information.step1: Unrack barbell and position on upper back.
information.step2: Set feet shoulder-width apart, brace core.
information.step3: Descend by bending hips and knees.
information.step4: Drive up to standing, keeping chest up.

information.description: A vertical pulling exercise targeting the lats using a cable machine.
information.step1: Sit at cable machine, grip bar wider than shoulders.
information.step2: Lean back slightly, pull bar to upper chest.
information.step4: Slowly return bar to starting position.

information.description: A hip-hinge movement targeting posterior chain muscles.
tips: Keep bar close to body throughout movement.
Engage lats to maintain bar path.
information.step1: Stand with feet hip-width, grip barbell overhand.
information.step2: Brace core, hinge hips back, lower bar to mid-shin.
information.step3: Keep back flat, drive through heels to stand.
information.step4: Lock out hips at top, repeat.

information.description: A horizontal pushing exercise targeting chest and triceps.
tips: Control the descent and drive through legs.
information.step1: Lie on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulders.
information.step2: Unrack bar, lower to mid-chest with control.
information.step3: Press bar up, locking out elbows.

information.step1: Grip pull-up bar, hands shoulder-width apart.
information.step3: Pull chest to bar by driving elbows down.
information.step4: Lower yourself back to dead hang.

information.description: A vertical pushing exercise for shoulders and triceps.
tips: Press bar in straight line overhead.
information.step1: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, grip barbell at chest.
information.step2: Brace core and press bar overhead.
information.step4: Lower bar to chest with control.

tips: Squeeze shoulder blades together at top.
information.step1: Place knee and hand on bench, hold dumbbell in other hand.
information.step2: Pull dumbbell to hip, keeping elbow close.

information.description: A seated leg extension exercise using a machine.
tips: Control the descent and avoid locking knees.
information.step1: Sit on leg press machine, feet on platform.
information.step2: Release safety and lower platform by bending knees.
information.step3: Descend until knees are at 90 degrees.
information.step4: Press platform up by extending legs.

information.description: An isolation exercise targeting the biceps.
tips: Control both up and down phases.
information.step1: Stand holding dumbbells at sides, palms forward.
information.step2: Curl weights up by bending elbows.

information.description: A bodyweight exercise targeting triceps and chest.
tips: Lower until arms are parallel to ground.
information.step1: Grip parallel bars and support body weight.
information.step3: Descend until arms are parallel to ground.
information.step4: Press back up to starting position.

information.description: A core stability exercise performed in prone position.
tips: Maintain straight line from head to heels.
Engage core and glutes throughout hold.
information.step1: Start in prone position, elbows under shoulders.
information.step2: Lift body off ground, balancing on toes and forearms.
information.step3: Maintain straight line from head to heels.
information.step4: Hold position, engaging core and glutes.

information.description: A unilateral leg exercise emphasizing balance and coordination.
information.step2: Step forward with one leg, lowering body.
information.step3: Descend until both knees are at 90 degrees.
information.step4: Push through front heel to stand and repeat.
